1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Align one gently warped three-character plate with a broad tolerance and short initial displacement.
1.natural_language: Register the color plate, lock it, then press.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Align two differently warped four-character plates. Their joint impression has a narrower tolerance and larger initial offsets.
2.natural_language: Register both color plates, lock them, then press.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Preserves the existing three-plate, five-character registration: three nonlinear impressions must converge before all locks and the press are accepted.
3.natural_language: Register all three color plates, lock them, then press.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Align four densely warped six-character plates. More simultaneous registration variables and a tighter optical tolerance make the residual distortion harder to localize.
4.natural_language: Register all four color plates, lock them, then press.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Align five strongly warped seven-character plates. Five coupled residual impressions, wider deformation, and the narrowest tolerance require repeated visual correction before locking.
5.natural_language: Register all five color plates, lock them, then press.

simplified.summary: Use visible per-plate minus and plus step buttons to rotate each wheel, then use the unchanged lock and press controls.

full.summary: Drag each physical wheel directly to rotate its plate, then use the unchanged lock and press controls.
